skipped.detail: Requires inducing a Gopay timeout. No WireMock/MockServer/Toxiproxy in gofood, :core or :gojek-commons - mechanism absent, not a missing config. A test that cannot induce its own precondition is dead code.

Requires asserting the chat-extension job was enqueued. The Kafka assertion MECHANISM exists (kafka/Base/KafkaAssertions + KafkaJudge + LogWiseKafkaAssertions, used by TuringEtaTest) but there is no Judge/proto for a chat-extension topic, and it is unconfirmed the job even travels over Kafka.
e2e attach + all-jobs assertions: carries SC-007's gap and additionally needs a real social group. The /invite layer added here unblocks its request half.
